description: This file contains classes and functions for partitioning computational graphs in PyTorch, specifically for higher-order operations. It includes classes for managing partitioned graphs, renaming placeholders, removing redundant size operations, marking complex expressions, and creating joint graphs for partitioning.

classes.name: HopPartitionedGraph
classes.description: Represents a partitioned graph with methods to check validity and reorder outputs.

classes.name: HopJointGraph
classes.description: Represents a joint graph for forward and backward passes, with methods to rename placeholders, remove size ops, mark complex expressions, and partition the graph.

methods.name: _find_hop_subgraph_outputs
methods.description: Finds the output nodes of a given GraphModule.

methods.name: is_complex_expr
methods.description: Determines if an expression is complex (not a symbol or constant).

methods.name: create_hop_joint_graph
methods.description: Creates a joint graph for a forward function and its arguments, optionally functionalized.
